Short title and commencement

ORDER 8 OF 2000
LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS ORDER, 2000
ORDER 8 OF 2000
An Order to provide conduct of Local
Government Elections by the Chief Election Commissioner
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
30th September, 2000]
No.2‑13/2000/Min‑1, dated 30‑9‑2000.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for the
conduct of Local Government Elections by the Chief Election Commissioner.
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the
Local Government Elections Order, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Conduct of Local Government Election by the Chief Election Commissioner

ORDER 8 OF 2000
LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS ORDER, 2000
ORDER 8 OF 2000
An Order to provide conduct of Local
Government Elections by the Chief Election Commissioner
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
30th September, 2000]
No.2‑13/2000/Min‑1, dated 30‑9‑2000.
Whereas it is expedient to provide for the
conduct of Local Government Elections by the Chief Election Commissioner.
2. Conduct of Local Government Election by the
Chief Election Commissioner.‑‑The Chief Election Commissioner is hereby
empowered to conduct Local Government Elections for the Province and for that
purpose the Chief Election Commissioner shall have the power and authority to
take all such steps and measures including preparation of electoral rolls and
delimitation of wards and to adopt such procedure, do such acts, pass such
orders, issue such directions and take all such ancillary, incidental and
consequential steps as he may deem necessary for effectively carrying out the
said elections.
(Sd.)
General Pervez Musharaf,
Chief Executive of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, Joint Chief of Staff
Committee and Chief of Army Staff 30th September, 2000
